arguments.name: Cosmic dissociation as universal experiential grounding
premises: Experiential reality requires explanation and economy favors one kind if adequate.
Private perspectives can be modelled through disconnected cognitive associations.
Bodies/perception are posited as appearances and cross-boundary influences of cosmic experiential patterns.
bridge_principles: Clinical dissociation is a relevant analogy for private fields in a single conscious medium.
Access/impingement structure realizes the required subject and qualitative facts.
arguments.conclusion: A one-primitive cosmic account can accommodate the selected phenomena.
arguments.strongest_objection: Chalmers: accessibility does not by itself establish subject constitution; identity has interpersonal/introspection costs and nonidentity needs necessitation.
arguments.strongest_reply: Kastrup’s clinical/privacy and appearance account makes the intended mechanism explicit; Chalmers himself grants cognitive-fragmentation coherence, with qualifications.
unresolved_issues: No verified direct response to selected Chalmers idealism text
arguments.reply_relation: Kastrup2018 internal response to broader problem; analyst comparison with Chalmers, not a verified reply exchange

arguments.name: Conditional cosmic subject-constitution objection
premises: Cosmic subject and all its cosmic mental states can seemingly be conceived without further distinct macrosubjects.
Constitution requires the subject facts to be fixed by the ground.
arguments.conclusion: Pure cosmic grounding of distinct macrosubjects faces a serious conditional objection.
arguments.strongest_objection: Identity cosmopsychism denies further numerically distinct subjects; hidden constitutive facts or failure of modal bridges may defeat the inference.
arguments.strongest_reply: Chalmers allows mode-relative fragmentation as coherent but documents identity/introspection costs; nonidentity approaches still owe a subject relation.
unresolved_issues: Whether cognitive mode-relativity handles phenomenal and interpersonal difference
arguments.reply_relation: Actual constructive responses considered by Chalmers; Kastrup2018 not asserted to answer this exact text

arguments.name: Plural substantial unity and internally lawful representation
premises: Mechanical aggregates do not explain perception.
Each monad has an intrinsic representational nature and qualitative individuality.
God creates and coordinates substances and their laws.
bridge_principles: Divine coordination grounds consistent representations and ordinary causal descriptions without influx.
arguments.conclusion: Plural created perceivers express one world without forming one numerically identical subject.
arguments.strongest_objection: Foucher questions unextended foundations, organic/mental unity, and why externally coordinated bodies are needed if appearances are internally sufficient.
arguments.strongest_reply: Leibniz distinguishes genuine unities from aggregates and abstract extension from corporeal mass; intrinsic lawfulness and divine preference for plurality answer the intended explanandum.
unresolved_issues: Perception is not automatically apperceptive consciousness
arguments.reply_relation: NewSystem1695 defended in1696; Monadology1714 is later developed comparison, not same target

arguments.name: Unnecessary bodies and post hoc coordination
premises: Soul appearances could seem the same without appropriate bodies or motions.
A theory built to save prior separations may not be independently justified.
bridge_principles: Explanatory economy and epistemic justification favor avoiding unnecessary untested entities.
Effort/resistance may permit interaction unless excluded by defended premises.
arguments.conclusion: Leibniz owes justification for bodies and harmony beyond possible coordination.
arguments.strongest_objection: Leibniz says harmony follows from true unities, laws are internal, and God values more substances with external correspondence.
arguments.strongest_reply: Leibniz’s actual1696reply treats harmony as law-grounded rather than recurring intervention, permits revised ordinary causal language, and defends a priori reasons plus empirical fit.
unresolved_issues: The reply excludes countercases conditional on harmony rather than new observation
arguments.reply_relation: Verified actual1696reply to Foucher1695; no later reply fabricated
